questions.prompt: In a workspace-write session, a person approves one escalated install to danger-full-access. The model then runs rm -rf ~/old without sandbox_permissions. Which mode does that command run in?
options: danger-full-access, because the session was widened
read-only, because escalation narrows the next call
workspace-write, because the grant covered only the approved call
No mode, because it needs a new approval first
questions.explanation: The approved mode is used for the one call that asked. The session's mode is unchanged, so the next call runs in workspace-write.

questions.prompt: A session in workspace-write sends sandbox_permissions: "read-only". What happens?
options: The tool fails before asking anyone, because read-only is not wider than workspace-write
A person is asked to approve read-only
The command runs in workspace-write and ignores the field
questions.explanation: Only a strictly wider mode can be requested. read-only is narrower, so the check fails and no approval question is sent.

questions.prompt: The person answers no to an escalation. What does the error tell the model to do?
options: Stop and explain instead of working around the denial
Switch the session to full access
questions.explanation: A person's no is final. The error text says the call stays denied and that the model should stop and explain.
